note: Stay limits are for standard tourist entry without special visa. Actual limits depend on passport nationality. Database uses US/Canadian/EU passport as default — customize per user.

countries.name: Argentina
countries.notes: 90 days per 12-month period. Can extend 90 more at migraciones.gob.ar. Popular for South American nomads.

countries.name: Australia
countries.notes: eVisitor free for EU/UK citizens. 3 months stay per 12-month period.

countries.name: Austria
countries.notes: Schengen area. 90 days in any 180-day rolling window across ALL Schengen countries combined.

countries.name: Bolivia
countries.notes: 90 days, renewable for another 90. Tourist card required on entry.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.notes: 90 days extendable to 180. New digital nomad visa announced 2024.

countries.name: Canada
countries.notes: eTA required for visa-exempt nationals. Up to 6 months stay possible at border discretion.

countries.name: Chile
countries.notes: 90 days, renewable. Digital nomad visa available since 2024.

countries.name: Colombia
countries.notes: 90 days per 180-day period. Can extend 90 more. Excellent digital nomad visa (1 year).

countries.name: Costa Rica
countries.notes: 90 days tourist. 'Remote Worker' visa for up to 1 year available.

countries.name: Cyprus
countries.notes: Not yet in Schengen but follows 90/180. Popular digital nomad destination.

countries.name: Germany
countries.notes: Schengen area. Freelancer visa possible but not true nomad visa.

countries.name: Ecuador
countries.notes: 90 days tourist, renewable. Digital nomad visa since 2024.

countries.name: Estonia
countries.notes: Schengen. First country to launch dedicated digital nomad visa (2020).

countries.name: Spain
countries.notes: Schengen. DNV available since 2023. Very popular for nomads.

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.notes: Up to 6 months as Standard Visitor. No digital nomad visa.

countries.name: Greece
countries.notes: Schengen. DNV available. 90/180 rule for tourists.

countries.name: Guatemala
countries.notes: 90 days. Part of CA-4 agreement with Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua — shared 90 days.

countries.name: Hong Kong
countries.notes: 90 days for US/Canadian/EU passports. No digital nomad visa.

countries.name: Ireland
countries.notes: Not Schengen. 90 days tourist. Long-stay options available.

countries.name: Italy
countries.notes: Schengen. Digital nomad visa pilot program.

countries.name: Japan

digital_nomad_visa.name: Digital Nomad Visa (Special Status of Residence)

countries.notes: 90 days visa-free for US/Canada/EU. New DNV launched April 2024.

countries.name: Monaco
countries.notes: Not Schengen but follows same 90/180 rule as Schengen.

countries.name: Malta
countries.notes: Schengen. One of the first DNV programs (2020).

countries.name: Mexico
countries.notes: Up to 180 days tourist. Temporary residency popular with nomads.

countries.name: New Zealand
countries.notes: NZeTA required. Up to 6 months for US citizens, 3 months for others.

digital_nomad_visa.name: Friendly Nations Visa / Remote Worker Permit

countries.name: Peru
countries.notes: Up to 184 days possible (depends on immigration officer). No official DNV.

countries.name: Philippines
countries.notes: 30 days initial, extendable to 36 months. SDNV launched 2024.

countries.name: Portugal
countries.notes: Schengen. D8 visa very popular. Can lead to residency.

countries.name: Romania
countries.notes: Schengen since March 2024 (partial — land/border not yet).

countries.name: Singapore

digital_nomad_visa.name: Global Business Mobility Pass / Digital Nomad Pass

countries.notes: 90 days visa-free. Digital Nomad Pass launched 2023.

countries.name: Thailand
countries.notes: 60 days visa-exempt + 60 extension. DTV launched 2024 — 5 years stay possible.

countries.name: Turkey
countries.notes: e-Visa required for most. 90 days in any 180-day period.

countries.name: Taiwan
countries.notes: 90 days visa-free for US/Canada. Extension possible.

countries.name: United States
countries.notes: ESTA required for VWP countries. 90 days B1/B2. No digital nomad visa.

countries.name: Uruguay
countries.notes: 90 days, renewable. Rentista visa for long stays.

countries.name: Vietnam
countries.notes: e-Visa up to 90 days since 2023. Visa-free 45 days for some nationalities.

countries.name: South Africa
countries.notes: 90 days visa-free for most Western passports.

countries.name: Cyprus
countries.notes: Not yet Schengen but follows 90/180. Popular for nomads.

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.notes: 90 days visa-free. DE Rantau pass for 1 year.

countries.name: Indonesia
countries.notes: 30 days visa-free, extendable once. KITAS nomad visa available.

countries.name: India
countries.notes: e-Visa required. Up to 90 days for tourist e-Visa.

countries.name: Qatar
countries.notes: 30 days visa-free, extendable. Nomad visa since 2017.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.notes: 90 days visa-free for many. Virtual Work Permit for 1 year.

countries.name: Georgia
countries.notes: 365 days visa-free for most Western passports! Most nomad-friendly country.

countries.name: Egypt
countries.notes: e-Visa or visa on arrival. 30 days.

countries.name: Senegal
countries.notes: 90 days visa-free for many Western passports.

countries.name: Maldives
countries.notes: 30 days free on arrival. Remote worker visa available.

countries.name: Nepal
countries.notes: Tourist visa on arrival. Up to 90 days possible.

countries.name: Myanmar
countries.notes: e-Visa available but travel advisory in effect.

countries.name: Cambodia
countries.notes: e-Visa or visa on arrival. 30 days.

countries.name: Bhutan
countries.notes: Tourism fee required. No visa-free entry.

countries.name: New Caledonia
countries.notes: French territory. Schengen visa may apply.

countries.name: Bahamas
countries.notes: 30 days visa-free. Beach Welcome remote worker program.

countries.name: Barbados
countries.notes: 30 days visa-free. Welcome Stamp for up to 1 year.

countries.name: Russia
countries.notes: Visa required. Travel advisory in effect.

rule_types.calendar_year: Days counted within a single calendar year (Jan 1 - Dec 31). Resets each January.
rule_types.rolling_90_180: Schengen-style: maximum 90 days in any rolling 180-day window. Moving window, not calendar year.
rule_types.rolling_window: Custom rolling window — check country-specific rules for exact period.
